verdict.rationale: Factory explicitly documents a /readiness-fix slash command that automatically fixes failing agent-readiness criteria, usable from the Factory App or Droid CLI, complementing the /readiness-report diagnostic command. This directly matches the story's ask, though only first-party docs support it with no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that /readiness-fix reliably resolves criteria, and detail on which criteria types it can/cannot auto-fix.
